## Type

- [ ] Bug fix (`fix/`)
- [ ] Feature (`feat/`)
- [ ] Visual / CSS only (`style/`)
- [ ] Fits neither (`chore/`)
- [ ] Translation
- [ ] Other

## Checklist

- [ ] Branch is named `feat/...`, `fix/...`, `style/...` or `chore/...` and targets `main`
- [ ] Tested with the extension loaded unpacked (popup opens, no console errors)
- [ ] Checked light and dark themes (if the UI changed)
- [ ] Checked settings functionalities work
- [ ] User-facing strings go through the i18n layer and are added to `en.js`
- [ ] No `innerHTML`; DOM built with `createElement` / `textContent`
- [ ] I did not bump the `manifest.json` version or add release notes (the maintainer handles releases)
